acceptance.given: A retained evaluation-seed record is recorded or evaluated through the Toolchain replay path, with its classification and any TC-D1 baseline or evaluation-set membership fields available to the validator.

oracle.expected: The validator observes exactly one classification per retained seed, and that classification is one of anchor_candidate, challenge_candidate, or non_baseline_exploratory_candidate; the record is not treated as a baseline or evaluation-set member within TC-D1.
forbidden: Any classification outside the closed approved non-baseline set is accepted.
A retained seed is classified as a baseline or evaluation-set member within TC-D1.
A missing, duplicated, or ambiguous classification is accepted.
oracle.observable: The emitted validation result contains a deterministic pass/fail decision and per-seed classification check identifying the retained seed, its single approved classification, and the absence of prohibited baseline or evaluation-set membership.

acceptance.then: The classification contract is enforced for every retained evaluation seed and the result remains non-authorizing.
acceptance.when: The replay/seed validation invocation evaluates a retained evaluation seed record.

failure_intents.selector_intent: S7 test_s7.py mutates one retained seed classification to an unapproved value or adds baseline/evaluation-set membership, then verifies the validator rejects the record with a deterministic contract failure.

affected_subjects: retained evaluation seed records and their TC-D1 classification fields
slice_hint.behavior_change: scripts/sc/skill_package_replay.py must validate each retained evaluation seed against the closed classification set {anchor_candidate, challenge_candidate, non_baseline_exploratory_candidate}, require exactly one classification, and reject any baseline or evaluation-set membership within TC-D1. The S7 test provides an isolated invalid-classification fixture and asserts the rejection without changing unrelated seed semantics.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay and seed-manifest interfaces; rollback removes only the classification-boundary enforcement and its focused test changes, without altering historical seed records or adding baseline authority.

slice_hint.state_transition: A retained seed record transitions from unverified classification to validated non-baseline classification, or to a deterministic unsuccessful terminal result when classification is missing, ambiguous, disallowed, or promotes baseline/evaluation-set membership.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The invocation is successful only if every retained seed has exactly one approved non-baseline classification and no TC-D1 baseline or evaluation-set membership; any violation yields an unsuccessful semantic-contract result.
